title: QUIC server-side resumption ticket issuance verification
verification_method: Focused requirement-home tests with positive, negative, and fuzz-shaped coverage plus regression, build, full-suite, generated-triage, and SpecTrace JSON validation.
scope: Verify that opt-in managed server resumption ticket issuance publishes a bounded TLS 1.3 NewSessionTicket over the QUIC 1-RTT CRYPTO seam without changing the default server path or claiming PSK acceptance.
preconditions: The managed server has completed peer Finished verification.
1-RTT open and protect packet-protection material is available.
The internal server resumption-ticket issuance switch is enabled.
procedure: Run the focused REQ-QUIC-CRT-0150 requirement-home tests.
Confirm the enabled server path publishes exactly one 1-RTT CRYPTO update carrying a TLS NewSessionTicket with bounded lifetime, nonce, ticket, and no early_data extension.
Confirm the runtime can flush the enabled 1-RTT CRYPTO bytes as an additional protected application-data datagram when an active path exists.
Confirm the disabled/default server path does not publish or buffer a resumption ticket.
Repeat enabled issuance across randomized ticket material to keep the serialized NewSessionTicket shape bounded.
Regenerate requirement coverage triage and validate the core SpecTrace profile.
expected_result: The managed server emits a bounded opt-in NewSessionTicket after 1-RTT key availability, the runtime flushes it on the 1-RTT CRYPTO path when an active path exists, and the default path remains ticket-free. Resumption acceptance remains blocked on future PSK cache, binder validation, ServerHello selection, and PSK-DHE derivation work.

supplemental_sections.heading: Acceptance Criteria
supplemental_sections.content:
- Enabled server issuance publishes one 1-RTT CRYPTO update containing a TLS NewSessionTicket.
- The ticket has a bounded lifetime, non-empty nonce, non-empty opaque ticket, and no early_data extension.
- Runtime 1-RTT CRYPTO egress drains when an active path and 1-RTT protect material are present.
- Disabled/default server issuance publishes no ticket and buffers no 1-RTT CRYPTO bytes.
- The interop resumption cell remains prerequisite-blocked until PSK acceptance is implemented.

status_summary: Passed locally for focused REQ-QUIC-CRT-0150 requirement-home coverage, interop inventory dry-run coverage, captured HRR/key-update regression coverage, regenerated QUIC triage, SpecTrace core validation, Release build, full Release tests, and diff whitespace validation.
